title: ExecutionLink
description: The athlete's manual link of a completed activity to a planned workout, or to none (the activity is UNPLANNED); one per activity, replaced by a newer link (P12). Executions themselves are a read model computed by execution rules 1.0.0; a link to a workout no longer in the ACTIVE plan is ignored. version is the storage revision. Owner spec: spec/functional/planning.spec.md section 6.
